author: GamingBolt
description:
While Kingdom Hearts Collection [I-III] doesn’t bring anything new to the table, this remains a series rooted by a strong emotional core. And that’s why, despite the convoluted mythology, the dated mechanics of its early titles, the strange side stories, and occasionally absurd narrative directions, a remarkably sincere belief consistently shines. 

People matter, and you don’t need to know every piece of Kingdom Hearts lore to understand that.
title: Kingdom Hearts Collection I - III PS5 Review: An Excellent Compilation Worth Your Time

author: GamingBolt
description:
Order of the Sinking Star probably won't end up as divisive as The Witness, and while I can see some players waiting to be wowed, even after dozens of puzzles, it doesn't take away from how well-structured and well-designed the world is as a whole, or how fun the mechanics can be, or the slight wrinkles thrown in that force you to rethink everything. 

If that sounds like the ideal puzzle experience for you, however many hours, mistakes and all, then it may be another incredible journey to get lost in, even with its imperfections and quirks.
title: Order of The Sinking Star Review - The Final Verdict

author: GamingBolt
description:
Gears of War: E-Day is already in some of your hands, and we’re happy about that since we can finally start talking to you about how much we loved it! Of course, we know more of you out there are waiting to play the game, and we’re going to make sure we don’t spoil anything for you.

But we’ve GOT to talk to you about Kalona, and how the city serves as the perfect staging ground for the beginning of the Locust invasion and the COG’s struggle to repel these mysterious new foes in the war’s early days. 

Of course, it’s always nice to see Marcus again, but the city might just be the star of the show in E-Day. We’re happy to explain if you’re curious about why we think so.
title: Gears of War: E-Day's Kalona Might Be One of Gaming's Best Depictions of Urban Warfare

author: GamingBolt
description:
Hot on the heels of August’s Enhanced Edition, Crimson Desert developer is readying the colossal open world adventure’s first major DLC – and it’s a typically sizeable update. Crimson Desert: Charting the Unknown is appropriately titled, with the expansion leading you beyond Pywel’s shores, crossing oceans to discover unseen lands, mysteries, and secrets. 

And, away from naval exploration, the DLC makes life richer on dry land with lucrative ways to manage property. There’s quite a lot to unpack, so let’s get to it. Here’s fifteen things you need to know about Crimson Desert’s upcoming expansion: Charting the Unknown.
title: Crimson Desert: Charting The Unknown - 15 Things You Need To Know Before You Buy
